nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances of every account.
ERC20 private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spending allowances.
ERC20 private uint256 tracking the total supply of KBT tokens.
AccessControl private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) storing role members and admin role for each role.
Initializable private bool indicating the contract has already been initialized.
Initializable private bool indicating the contract is currently in the middle of an initializer call.
Public constant hard cap on total supply (12000000000000000000000000) enforced when minting.
Public initializer guarded by the initializer modifier; sets token metadata, admin/owner roles and role admins, and assigns ownership to msg.sender.
Public onlyMinter function that mints new tokens to an account and emits Minted.
Public ERC20 transfer overridden with the notBlacklisted(msg.sender) modifier.
Public ERC20 transferFrom overridden with the notBlacklisted(sender) modifier.
Hook executed before any transfer/mint/burn; enforces totalSupply + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY when minting (from == address(0)).
Internal override invoked by Blacklistable.destroyFrom; burns tokens from a blacklisted account.
Internal ERC20 transfer that validates addresses, calls the before-transfer hook and updates _balances.
Internal ERC20 mint that increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance.
Internal ERC20 burn that decreases the account balance and _totalSupply.
Internal ERC20 allowance setter used by approve/transferFrom/allowance helpers.
External onlyOwner function granting the BLACKLISTED_ROLE to an account.
Public onlyOwner function that requires the account to be blacklisted and then destroys its tokens via _destroy.
Public AccessControl function granting a role; requires the caller to hold the role's admin role.
Public AccessControl function allowing an account to renounce a role it holds for itself.
Public onlyAdmin function granting DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to a new account.
Public function letting an admin renounce its own DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and requiring at least one admin to remain.
Context helper returning msg.sender, used for GSN-compatible sender resolution.
Initializable helper using inline assembly extcodesize on address(this) to detect constructor execution.
Private AccessControl function adding an account to a role's member set and emitting RoleGranted.
Private AccessControl function removing an account from a role's member set and emitting RoleRevoked.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and captured as the owner during initialize.
Token creation site: mint() creates new supply credited to an arbitrary account address.
Token destruction site: destroyFrom()/burn() burns tokens from an account without the holder's consent.
Inline assembly extcodesize(self) used to determine whether the contract is under construction.
Privileged role mutation: grantRole/revokeRole/_grantRole modify the _roles permission store.
Initializer state transition writing _initializing/_initialized, which decides whether initialize() may run.
Address passed to initialize() that becomes the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder.
Recipient account parameter of mint().
Amount of tokens to mint, parameter of mint().
Recipient parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom(), also used for the blacklist check.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Origin address of the transfer hook; address(0) denotes a mint.
Destination address of the transfer hook; address(0) denotes a burn.
Amount compared against MAX_SUPPLY in the transfer hook.
Account passed to _destroy() whose balance will be burned.
Amount passed to _destroy() to be burned.
bytes32 role identifier parameter of grantRole().
Account parameter of grantRole() that receives the role.
Amount parameter of ERC20Burnable.burn().
Boolean capturing whether the initializer invocation is the outermost call.
Address of the contract being tested with extcodesize in _isConstructor.
Code size value returned by the extcodesize assembly call in _isConstructor.
Computed remaining allowance in ERC20Burnable.burnFrom before burning.

edges.reason: initialize() assigns ownership to msg.sender via _Owned(admin, msg.sender), so the caller directly controls a privileged role.
mint() is guarded by onlyMinter(msg.sender); the caller identity gates token creation.
transfer() is guarded by notBlacklisted(msg.sender), making the caller identity an authorization input.
transferFrom() is guarded by notBlacklisted(sender) while the caller supplies the allowance via _msgSender().
grantRole() requires the caller to hold the target role's admin role before granting privileges.
renounceRole() requires msg.sender to equal the account whose role is being renounced.
renounceAdmin() revokes DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE from msg.sender and then enforces the surviving admin count.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller into the role system.
initialize() writes the role configuration into _roles via _Owned/_Admined/_Mintable/_Blacklistable.
initialize() sets _initialized to true through the initializer modifier.
initialize() reaches _grantRole through _Admined/_Owned/_setupRole to register the admin and owner.
initialize() execution depends on the initializer gate that flips _initializing/_initialized.
mint() delegates supply creation to the internal ERC20 _mint helper.
mint() is the entry point that triggers the token creation unsafe operation.
mint() emits Minted with msg.sender as the operator, tying the untrusted caller to the mint event.
transfer() forwards to the internal _transfer implementation.
transfer() passes _msgSender() as the source of the internal transfer.
transferFrom() calls _transfer(sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom() calls _approve to deduct the spent allowance.
_transfer() mutates the _balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
_transfer() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before writing balances.
_transfer() reads the sender balance that is part of the total supply accounting.
_beforeTokenTransfer compares totalSupply().add(amount) against the MAX_SUPPLY constant, a supply-cap arithmetic check.
_beforeTokenTransfer adds the pending amount to _totalSupply before comparing with the cap.
_mint() credits the minted amount to the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint() increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_mint() calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook, an indirect callback into derived contract logic during supply changes.
_burn() debits the burned amount from the account entry of _balances.
_burn() reduces _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
_burn() invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook during destruction.
destroyFrom() calls the abstract _destroy implementation after checking the blacklist.
destroyFrom() triggers the forced token burning unsafe operation on a blacklisted holder.
ShareBondToken._destroy() implements destruction by calling ERC20 _burn.
blacklist() grants BLACKLISTED_ROLE through _grantRole.
blacklist() mutates the _roles structure for the BLACKLISTED_ROLE members.
addAdmin() calls grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, account).
renounceAdmin() calls renounceRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender).
grantRole() performs the actual membership insertion in _grantRole.
grantRole() performs the privileged role mutation unsafe operation.
renounceRole() delegates to _revokeRole for the self-revocation.
_grantRole() writes the account into _roles[role].members.
_revokeRole() removes the account from _roles[role].members.
_grantRole() emits RoleGranted using _msgSender() as the sender field.
_isConstructor() executes the inline assembly extcodesize unsafe operation.
_isConstructor() stores address(this) in the local variable self.
_isConstructor() stores the extcodesize result in the local variable cs.
The isTopLevelCall local drives the _initializing/_initialized writes in the initializer gate.
_destroy() consumes the account parameter whose balance is burned.
_destroy() consumes the amount parameter to be burned.
mint() forwards the account parameter to _mint.
mint() forwards the amount parameter to _mint.
transfer() forwards the recipient parameter to _transfer.
transfer() forwards the amount parameter to _transfer.
transferFrom() forwards the sender parameter to _transfer and _approve.
transferFrom() forwards the recipient parameter to _transfer.
transferFrom() forwards the amount parameter to _transfer and allowance deduction.
_beforeTokenTransfer branches on the from parameter to detect minting.
_beforeTokenTransfer receives the to parameter for the hook signature.
_beforeTokenTransfer uses the amount parameter in the MAX_SUPPLY cap addition.
grantRole() uses the role parameter to look up the admin role and membership set.
grantRole() passes the account parameter to _grantRole.
ERC20Burnable.burn() passes its amount parameter to _burn.
burnFrom() computes decreasedAllowance which is later consumed together with the burn call.
initialize() passes the admin parameter into _Admined, granting the initial DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

normalization_plan.reason: The admin parameter is only consumed by initialize() to seed the admin role, so it should be folded into the initialize function node.
The account parameter of mint() only exists to forward into _mint and the Minted event, so collapse into mint().
The amount parameter of mint() is only used by the mint call site, so collapse into mint().
The recipient parameter of transfer() is directly forwarded to _transfer, so fold into transfer().
The amount parameter of transfer() is directly forwarded to _transfer, so fold into transfer().
The sender parameter of transferFrom() drives both _transfer and the allowance deduction, so fold into transferFrom().
The recipient parameter of transferFrom() is directly forwarded to _transfer, so fold into transferFrom().
The amount parameter of transferFrom() is used for the transfer and allowance subtraction, so fold into transferFrom().
The from parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer is only used for the mint branch check, so fold into the hook function node.
The to parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer is an unused hook signature value, so fold into the hook function node.
The amount parameter of _beforeTokenTransfer participates in the MAX_SUPPLY arithmetic, so fold into the hook function node.
The account parameter of _destroy is directly consumed by the burn logic, so fold into _destroy().
The amount parameter of _destroy is directly consumed by the burn logic, so fold into _destroy().
The role parameter of grantRole() is only used for role lookups and membership insertion within grantRole, so fold into grantRole().
The account parameter of grantRole() is only passed to _grantRole, so fold into grantRole().
The amount parameter of burn() is forwarded straight into _burn, so fold into the _burn function node.
The isTopLevelCall local exclusively controls the _initializing/_initialized writes of the initializer gate, so fold into that unsafe operation.
The self local is only the address(this) value used by the extcodesize check in _isConstructor, so fold into _isConstructor().
The cs local only stores the extcodesize return value inside _isConstructor, so fold into _isConstructor().
The decreasedAllowance local exists only to feed the ERC20Burnable burnFrom flow into _burn, so fold into the _burn function node.
